email.title: Email
email.description: The address the account registered with (C85). Registration accepts only this one email; account.schema.json adds additional_emails. Keep the two schemas in step.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.description: A required contact number, not an identifier: never used to log in, not verified by Kratos, and may be shared between accounts (C85). Kratos keeps verification addresses unique, so it has no verification block.

picture.title: Picture
picture.description: An optional address of the person's picture, filled from Google's picture claim (oidc.google.jsonnet).
